✦Amenities & essentials

Electricity activation

Insert the card attached to your keys into the holder inside the apartment to activate electricity.

Keys

The lockbox contains one property key and the electricity card. Leave the key in the lockbox if your group separates. A second key may be requested for €15 per day.

Parking

Park in any available space in the parking lot. The gate code is 1960#.

Pool access (code: C6533Y)

The pool is communal. Please respect neighbours and follow posted pool rules.

Ordering food

Use the full property address shown above for delivery orders.

Garbage disposal

Use the large green bins on the main streets.

Emergency numbers

For an emergency in Cyprus, call 112 or 199.

24/7 pharmacy

Cyprus operates an on-call pharmacy system. Find a pharmacy in Maps ↗

✓House rules

  • Do not use towels to remove makeup or tanning oils.
  • No parties, loud music, or excessive noise.
  • Respect quiet hours and be considerate of neighbours.
  • Use Wi‑Fi legally.
  • Only toilet paper may be flushed.
  • No drugs.
  • No smoking inside the property.
  • No pets.
  • Keep the property clean and tidy during your stay.
  • Do not leave windows open while air conditioning is running.
  • Do not move furniture or rearrange items.
  • Do not remove towels, linens, or other items from the property.
  • Report damage or issues as soon as possible.
  • Check-out time must be respected unless otherwise agreed.

?Quick help

How do I open the lockbox?

Enter the code supplied with your booking, then push the small release button down. Remove the key and close the box securely.

Why is the electricity off?

Insert the electricity card attached to the keys into the wall holder inside the apartment.

How do I get hot water?

Use the hot-water control inside the apartment. Allow a short time for the water to heat before showering.

How should I use the air conditioning?

Keep doors and windows closed while it is running. Switch it off when leaving the apartment.
